title: Relaxation of a Vlasov gas to an inhomogeneous state due to phase space mixing in an axisymmetric potential: A Newtonian analogy of the Kerr orbital motion
summary: We explore the dynamics of a Vlasov gas propagating in an external axisymmetric potential consisting of a central potential with an additional quadrupolar component which gives rise to two potential wells along the symmetry axis. Employing independently $N$-particle simulations and statistical methods, we show that an initially homogeneous and isotropic configuration evolves to an inhomogeneous final state with overdensities located at the wells.
